title: Reading an outdated asset

captions.instagram:
How do you see value in an outdated building? Score it.

Six factors I'd look at: location, future demand, building condition, neighborhood change, zoning and construction feasibility. Score each from 1 to 5, compare, then decide.

Save the scorecard.

#RealEstate #Investing #UrbanDevelopment

What would your building score?
captions.facebook:
Old building, good bones? I made a 6-factor scorecard for judging any property before you fall for it.

#RealEstate #Investing

Which factor do people overlook most?
captions.linkedin:
Score it before you fall for it.

An outdated building can hide real value, or real problems. Six factors I'd score: location (is it somewhere people want to be?), future demand (will they still want to be there?), building condition, neighborhood change, zoning (what can it legally become?) and construction feasibility.

Score each from 1 to 5. Compare properties side by side. Then decide.

#RealEstate #Investing

Which factor would you weigh most?
